parse.title: Troll Stronghold
parse.wikitext:
==Required for completing==
Completion of Troll Stronghold is required for the following:
* [[Desert Treasure I]]
* [[Devious Minds]]
* [[Eadgar's Ruse]]
* [[Monkey Madness II]]
* [[Troll Romance]]
* {{SCP|Agility|15|link=yes}} and defeating [[Dad]] are prerequisites for entry to the [[God Wars Dungeon]] (without [[Ghommal's hilt 1|Ghommals Hilt]]).
